steps.caption: Client accounts
steps.narration: Here's how to read the client list and find one account in it.

steps.caption: One client
steps.narration: Each client under the MCC is one row: its customer ID, its name, and its status.

steps.caption: Details
steps.narration: Details show the currency, the timezone, the Click Guard mapping, and when it was last checked.

steps.caption: No LSA campaigns found
steps.narration: No LSA campaigns found means the account was checked and runs no Local Services campaigns.

steps.caption: Not checked yet
steps.narration: LSA not checked and Never audited: this account hasn't had an audit yet.

steps.caption: A suspended account
steps.narration: A suspended account shows its status and the reason, and can't be ticked.

steps.caption: Campaigns
steps.narration: Campaigns opens the campaigns from the last audit, with their IDs and types.

steps.caption: Filters
steps.narration: Filters adds a status filter and an LSA filter.

steps.caption: LSA identified
steps.narration: Choose LSA identified to keep only the accounts running Local Services.

steps.caption: Search
steps.narration: Type a name or a customer ID to narrow it further.

steps.caption: Menu: Client accounts
steps.narration: Client accounts is in the Agency Ads and LSA menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to read the client account list | ConstructHUB Agency Ads
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the Client accounts list in the ConstructHUB Agency Ads & LSA manager. You will read a client's status, currency, timezone and LSA result, open its campaigns, filter by Local Services and search for one account.
